chunks: From him, from al-Hasan ibn Bint Ilyas, from Jamil ibn Darrāj and Muhammad ibn Humrān together, from Zurārah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
“It is obligatory for the mustahadah to consider some of her womenfolk and follow their menstrual patterns, then add one day as precaution to that.”

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing istihadah, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.بِأَقْرَائِهَا: by their menstrual cycles or periods
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرَ: to add precautionary days beyond the estimated period
key_terms.تَنْظُرَ: to consider or examine as a basis for judgment
key_terms.فَتَقْتَدِيَ: to follow or take as a model
key_terms.نِسَائِهَا: her womenfolk, meaning female relatives whose patterns are consulted

ai.seo_question: How should a mustahadah estimate her menstrual period according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the mustahadah regarding how to estimate her period when determining her state. She is instructed to look to the menstrual patterns of related women and then add one extra day as a precaution.
